description: This file defines the main React component for a weather dashboard application, including UI logic, state management, API interactions, geolocation, and suggestions handling.

methods.name: formatDay
methods.description: Formats a date string into a short weekday name.

methods.name: persistLastLocation
methods.description: Stores the last location (search or geo) in localStorage.

methods.name: readLastLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the last location from localStorage.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches weather data for a given query and updates state.

methods.name: loadByCoords
methods.description: Fetches weather data based on latitude and longitude.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission for location search.

methods.name: handleDetectLocation
methods.description: Uses Geolocation API to detect user's current location.

methods.name: handleSelectSuggestion
methods.description: Handles selection of a suggested location.
